name: Live-preview pair with a glowing connector
looks: A feature headline lands with one word in the accent colour and italic. Two small cards sit side by side, raw text on the left and its live-rendered twin on the right, joined at the seam by a small glowing icon that pulses to mark the connection as active.
build: list-stack-reveal for the two-line headline; provenance-glow-stroke for the connector icon, its glow intensity a pure function of the clock, pulsing independent of the cards' own fade-in.
sound: A tick per headline line and a soft electric hum under the connector's pulse.
prompt: Mark a feature as live, not static: sit two small panels side by side, one the input and one its live-updating twin, and join them at the seam with a small glowing marker that pulses to say this connection is active right now.
